verdict: A near pixel-faithful rebuild with every element and icon right; the visible gaps are the featured card's too-round corners (~24 dp vs 16 dp) and slightly tighter extract leading, and the auto-layout structure is clean but under-uses components and has no styles or variables.

top_defects.what: corner radius about 23-24 dp (about 61 px at 2.625) instead of the reference's 16 dp (about 42 px); the top corners light up in the heatmap
line height about 52 px instead of 53 px, so the lines drift 2-3 px upward (1925/1978/2031/2084 in the reference vs 1923/1975/2028/2081)

top_defects.where: bottom navigation labels (Saved, Search, Activity, More)
top_defects.what: labels a little heavier and shifted 1-3 px left/down compared with the reference's regular-weight labels

top_defects.where: "Featured article" description, second line, and article card title
top_defects.what: second line is 3-4 px wider (ends at x≈621 vs 617) and the serif title is about 8 px narrower (ends at x≈945 vs 953)
five nav items are copy-pasted frames rather than instances of a component; only Tab and the bookmark icon are components, and no color/text styles or variables are used (styled: 0)

top_defects.where: "For you" tab instance and article summary
top_defects.what: the instance keeps a 73 px indicator inside a 47 px tab (hidden leftover), and gaps carry float noise (11.600000381469727, 6.400000095367432)

strengths: Every text, icon, badge dot, logo and the article photo with its 39 % veil are present at the reference positions, with the measured colors (#3366cc tab, #e8f0ff pill, #eaecf0 banner)
Clear named hierarchy (Header, Tab bar, Community banner, Section header, Featured article card, Bottom navigation) with auto-layout on 33 of 42 frames
Real text and real vector icons from the app's assets, no screenshot pasted
